content.text:
Read-only closure review: not ready for acceptance.

- High — Any completing action disables the entire multi-node document. `ui-action-mutations.ts:87,124,188,199` marks the document completed; `UiDocumentRenderer.tsx:98,121-130` then disables every node. The smoke fixture itself has many sequential controls (`rendering-smoke.tsx:19-31`), so saving one resource can block quiz/deck/handoff actions.

- High — Journals are keyed only by model-authored `document_id` (`schema.ts:71-79`, `records.ts:500-514`), and restored by that ID alone (`UiDocumentRenderer.tsx:51-63`). Prompt IDs are merely “stable” and the example is static (`system-prompt.ts:23-30`). Reused IDs across sessions can restore another session’s answer/progress or cause replay conflict.

- High — Deck progress is not restart-safe. `DeckNode` always starts at card zero (`UiDocumentRenderer.tsx:266-284`); `rate-card` does not update node progress (`ui-action-mutations.ts:151-155`). A restart permits another rating of the same card under a new revision/idempotency key.

- Medium — Web handoff only opens `https://keating.help`; it does not transfer document/session context (`UiDocumentRenderer.tsx:383-391`).

- Medium — Tests cover pure parsing/mutations/journal replay, but not renderer-level multi-node interaction or restart. I ran the current mobile suite: 208 pass, 0 fail, 868 assertions.

Documentation is candid about missing full Mermaid/math/code/media/OpenUI-DSL/tool parity and absent physical device proof. However, its broader durable-action wording should not be treated as proving multi-node flows until the lifecycle and journal-scoping issues are fixed. The evidence count in docs (207/865) is stale relative to the current suite.

No files modified.

content.text:
Re-review result: the three prior high-severity OpenUI issues are closed in source and covered by focused tests.

- Multi-node controls remain usable: action mutations retain `ready` lifecycle at [ui-action-mutations.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/ui-action-mutations.ts:85), and the sibling-node regression test is present at [ui-action-mutations.test.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/test/ui-action-mutations.test.ts:49).
- Model-authored IDs are scoped before persistence using session/message/event identity at [KeatingProvider.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:612) and [ui-document-wire.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/ui-document-wire.ts:21).
- Deck cursor/completion restores from durable rating actions at [UiDocumentRenderer.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/UiDocumentRenderer.tsx:266); saved resource state also restores at [UiDocumentRenderer.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/UiDocumentRenderer.tsx:296).

Remaining medium issue: `BT` Mermaid is still rejected. The renderer has BT positioning/arrow logic ([MermaidDiagram.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/MermaidDiagram.tsx:20)), but the parser header accepts only `TD|TB|LR|RL` ([mermaid-native.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/mermaid-native.ts:22)). Direct smoke: `flowchart BT; A --> B` returns `null`, so it falls back to source rather than respecting BT. RL, style/subgraph directives, double-circle nodes, quoted labels, and fail-closed `click` handling work.

Full mobile suite passes: 211 tests, 0 failures, 880 assertions. Physical rendering/restart acceptance remains unverified.
